title: Paradigms of Interdependence
coreMove: Build interdependence by making trust deposits before you need trust; hard conversations spend the balance created by small reliable acts.

exampleSpecs.stakes: a delayed reply may drain parent trust
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: make a trust deposit through clarity

exampleSpecs.stakes: one apology can prevent a feud
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: repair a withdrawal before defending intent

exampleSpecs.stakes: a missed call may cost a long relationship
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: pay back a broken promise with specific action

exampleSpecs.stakes: unclear assumptions may disappoint a child
a friend loan may strain the relationship
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: choose integrity over a convenient delay

exampleSpecs.stakes: small discourtesy may spoil public trust
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: make a simple courtesy deposit under pressure
